plugin_media.title: Media optimizer
plugin_media.desc: Generate WebP copies for existing public images. Originals are kept; browsers that support WebP get the smaller file.
plugin_media.skippedOne: {{name}} is already optimized or cannot be converted; skipped
plugin_media.note: Conversion runs in the browser; originals are never overwritten. Requires the file upload permission. GIF / SVG are skipped.

video.configDesc: Videos upload straight to the provider; nothing is stored or transcoded locally. ABR and CDN come from the provider.
video.deleteConfirm: Delete the record for “{{name}}”? The asset on the provider side must be removed in its console.
video.copied: Link copied — paste it into the editor's Insert video dialog
video.noDownload: Playback subdomain is missing; no direct link yet

bunny.c: Pull zone subdomain (the xxx in xxx.b-cdn.net)

video.registerDesc: Paste the video ID from the cloud console. The playback URL is derived from the domain + ID; nothing is uploaded or transcoded here.
